name: StarkWare
rootCause: Quantitative trading company mgnr stated on Twitter that StarkWare has an urgent security issue, but did not disclose the specific details. Louis Guthmann, the head of ecology of the StarkWare team, confirmed that there is indeed a problem. “This is not a security vulnerability on dYdX. ) Is only related to a specific user." mgnr said he has contacted the StarkWare and Solana teams.
